# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c23 P30](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0030), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric is a handsome young boy who closely resembles his father, Stephen Stanhope. He wears an elegant fur cap and coat.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028)_

## Personality

Cedric is an extraordinarily imaginative, bright, and unusual child with a strong sense of manliness and self-assurance. He enjoys creative fancies and stone-people companions, yet maintains his ground in games and fights with other boys. Polite and friendly, he feels comfortable around adults and expresses his feelings directly.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034)_

## History

Cedric moved from Boston to Brierley to live with his grandmother near the shore road. He enrolled in the local school under Nell Harcourt, quickly becoming her favorite pupil due to his bright intelligence and vivid imagination. In a letter to Nell, he detailed his imaginative adventures with his "rock people" by the shore—such as Nora, the Twin Sailors, and the Golden Lady. Nell later brought Cedric to meet Miss Rosalind Penrose at her stone house. During the visit, Miss Rosalind recognized Cedric's strong resemblance to his father, Stephen Stanhope, and the two formed a warm friendship.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c11 P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 c11 P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c23 P24](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0024), [v2 c23 P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c23 P29](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0029), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034)_
